name: Sweet and Sour Chicken with Rice

components.name: Sweet and Sour Chicken
steps: Whisk soy sauce, packaged pineapple juice, honey, Worcestershire, vinegar, ketchup and cornflour together thoroughly until smooth.
Sauté onions and bell peppers over high heat with 15 ml peanut oil until charred but slightly crisp; set aside.
Add remaining oil and brown chicken in a single layer, working in batches to avoid steaming.
Add garlic and grated ginger for the last minute, then return the vegetables.
Pour in the pre-mixed sauce and boil for about 2 minutes, stirring until glossy and thickened; verify chicken reaches 74°C.
Divide chicken and sauce evenly with the cooked rice into five containers; cool promptly and freeze later-week portions.

components.name: Rice
steps: Cook washed rice with 600 ml cold water and 3 g salt; cover at low heat for about 12 minutes, then rest covered.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Using Chef Jack’s July 2026 version, NOT the older YouTube ingredient version with different honey/chicken quantities. Original creator macros provided separately.
Storing & reheating: Creator states up to 4 days refrigerated or 3 months frozen; keep rice separate if preferred, reheat sauce until hot throughout.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
